root_cause: Component implementation paths were classified as website work, but tests/components/ was absent from the delivery classifier, so a legitimate component regression fix was rejected as an unclassified delivery path.
prevention: Classify tests/components/ as website delivery work.
Whenever a new owned component test family is introduced, classify its test path in the same change.
Protect the classification with a direct delivery-plan regression.

evidence.outcome: Component test changes now enter the website lane instead of failing admission as unclassified.
